title: ITB Broker — Certification Portal Test Request

requestId.description: Portal-generated idempotency/tracking id for this submission.

name.description: SUT product name, e.g. 'Aga Khan EMR v2.1'.

certificationPortalSystemId.description: Portal's own id for this system record; links results back to the portal.

token.description: Bearer token, or 'user:password' for BASIC. Omit for NONE.

patientId.description: Optional, for scoping FHIR queries that require a patient context.

scenarioKey.description: Fixed catalog of scenario types the broker knows how to run. Must already be configured as such in ITB.

resourceType.description: FHIR resource type, e.g. 'Patient', 'Claim', 'Observation'. Dynamic — any resource type the SUT exposes for this scenario.

endpoint.description: Full SUT URL to call for this resource. Explicit per resource because SUTs don't reliably follow {baseUrl}/{ResourceType} conventions.

testType.description: READ = broker fetches from this endpoint and forwards to ITB for validation (Job 1+2). WRITE = broker POSTs a synthetic resource through ITB's write-verify endpoint (Job 3); 'endpoint' is retained for reference/logging but the actual write always goes through ITB, never directly to the SUT.
